_help: The field model (AndyMark field STEP converted to GLB, meters, Y up, origin at field center).
scale 39.37 turns meters into the sim's inches.
rotationYDeg spins the field so it lines up with Pedro's coordinates (red arrow = +x,
green arrow = +y, at the field corner Pedro calls (0, 0)).
0 is verified against the Pedro visualizer (same layout as DECODE): red hives 12.5in left
of center, red side box on the left wall at y 97-120, blue mirrored on the right.
